review_scope: Registered-source content review of arXiv:2211.14698v2 by Ziang Niu, Abhinav Chakraborty, Oliver Dukes and Eugene Katsevich. The PDF has 75 pages, with margin stamp 8 February 2023 and title-page date 10 February 2023. Main text and references end above y=288.68743896484375 on physical page 34. Only the heading of Appendix A was inspected below that boundary; no appendix body was read. Fresh text covers pages 1-33 and the clipped main-text portion of page 34. Statements, source definitions and boundary evidence were inspected visually.
inventory: Exactly three actual Theorem headings occur: Theorem 1 starts on page 8 and ends on page 9; Theorem 2 starts on page 12 and ends on page 13; Theorem 3 is on page 16. Two regular-font Theorem 3 references on page 18 are excluded. Lemmas, Propositions, Corollaries and appendix results are not included.
original_statements: Theorem 1 preserves both nondegeneracy conditions, the full conditional Lyap-1 sum and its positive exponent, the conditional d,p standard-normal limit and the conditional quantile limit. The full (X,Z) conditioning of learned predictor moments and (X,Y,Z) conditioning of the resampling distribution are retained. Conditional independence is not an implicit hypothesis.

Theorem 2 preserves null-class membership, SP1-prime, SP2, NDG2, signed variance consistency (23), and the complete Lyap-2 sum with the true conditional response residual moment. Both the variance ratio (25) and probability of equal test decisions (26) match the continuation on page 13. NDG1 is not added.

Theorem 3 preserves the null class, nuisance subspace, base-function set, all four assumptions (35)-(38), the OR branches in (36), exact conditional-mean membership and the eventually-in-class quantifier for every base and nuisance direction. The LAUMP(S) conclusion and full local power formula (39) remain unchanged.
source_passages: All 21 source entries and seven auxiliary passages were checked. The population variables, iid sample, script null-law class, uniform asymptotic level and true conditional means match pages 1-2 and 5-6. Bold population variables and plain sample arrays retain their source distinction.

Algorithm 1 preserves learning from (X,Z) and (Y,Z), conditional product resampling, the learned predictor-mean identity and the four-argument resampled statistic with nuisance fits held fixed. The raw residual-product functional is shared with GCM but does not itself require the full resampling kernel. The known-law dCRT and finite-M p-value remain separate context.

The GCM decision, statistic and empirical variance, the four in-sample error quantities, SP1 and SP2 match page 7. The weighted errors use the opposite-variable true variance. SP1-prime and its extra learned-variance-weighted response error match page 12 and remain distinct from SP1.

The conditional resampling variance, infinite-resampling dCRT decision, conditional quantile and Definition 1 match page 8. Resampling variance and empirical GCM variance remain separate objects. NDG2 remains a theorem excerpt reused in Theorem 2, while NDG1 and both Lyapunov conditions remain fully preserved inline in the theorems.

The fixed-dimensional GPLM alternatives (29)-(30), local paths (31), null/local testing problem (32), Definition 2 including both limiting power bounds and all direction/base quantifiers, and the unnamed scalar definition (34) match page 15. The scalar is retained as source context without an invented API name. Natural-language naming contexts on pages 7, 8 and 16 were checked.
dependency_review: All 25 direct uses, all 21 reach sets and all 37 related connections were checked. The sample, true means and raw statistic reach all three theorems. The null class, GCM, regression errors, SP1 and SP2 reach Theorems 2 and 3. Learned resampling, its statistic/variance, conditional quantiles and NDG2 reach Theorems 1 and 2. Conditional convergence reaches only Theorem 1. The full dCRT decision, signed variance consistency and SP1-prime reach only Theorem 2. Uniform asymptotic level, GPLM alternatives, local paths and LAUMP reach only Theorem 3. The GCM-only optimality result acquires no learned-kernel or resampling prerequisite.
names_and_highlights: Every member retains readable source-derived keywords and its original source heading. Selectors were checked against original formulas, assumption labels or related same-paper statements. Numbered definitions, named rate assumptions, source passages, the NDG2 theorem excerpt and the variance consistency condition remain distinct. The stable local IDs are preserved, including the existing gap at D17.
source_limitations: All 23 existing notes were reviewed. They distinguish conditional resampling normality from null validity; finite and infinite resampling; in-sample fitting and conditional independence of replacement draws; the common raw statistic; two variance definitions and undefined exceptional denominators; NDG1 versus NDG2; conditional convergence modes; Lyap-1 versus Lyap-2 and exponent scope; training-error and learned-variance weights; signed consistency; SP1 versus SP1-prime; fixed versus growing dimension; the alternative branches; exact nuisance-space membership; zero-direction paths and nonuniform eventual thresholds; pointwise-direction LAUMP versus uniform null level; the nonnegative square-root convention for s; conditional-kernel GPLM notation; measurability; and source version/shared-page boundaries. The source pointwise-versus-uniform rate distinction is preserved rather than silently repaired.
changes: No census-content correction was required. All six saved JSON artifacts and the original audit remain unchanged. Earlier scripts are archived. The saved rebuild now resolves the fixed verified local PDF, preserves the shared-page cutoff and works in an empty output directory.

Source identity, font-aware heading enumeration, multipage statement ranges, shared-page cutoff, all direct/local edge sets, reach sets and paths, selector occurrences and audit artifact hashes supplement the completed manual source review.
